Rolling Advertisement for Professor of Practice
Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University invites applications in prescribed application form
(attached below) from interested individuals for engagement against posts of Professor of
Practice, in different Schools/Departments of the University.
The details of the School/Department for which Professors of Practice are sought, eligibility
and general conditions, duties and responsibilities, procedure for selection and other
conditions etc. required for the above-mentioned posts are mentioned below:

 Proven track record in senior management positions or as entrepreneurs, consultants,
or professionals in government, private sector, or research organizations.
 Demonstrated expertise in bridging academic knowledge with practical application.
 Retired professionals with an outstanding career record are also encouraged to apply.
 Academic qualification (Ph.D.) is not mandatory; practical experience is emphasized.
Responsibilities:
 Delivering specialized lectures and practical training based on industry trends and
innovations.
 Mentoring students on projects, internships, and research activities with real-world
perspectives.
 Engaging in collaborative research and innovation projects between the university
and industry.
 Contributing to curriculum development that integrates industry requirements with
academic learning.
 Supporting entrepreneurial initiatives and start-ups within the university ecosystem.
Terms of Appointment:
Flexible contract terms with a tenure of up to 1 year, renewable based on performance and
university needs.
Compensation will be commensurate with experience and qualification.
How to Apply:
Interested candidates are requested to submit their completed application form along with
self-attested photocopies of their documents through email to the Registrar, CSJM
University (registrar@csjmu.ac.in) with the subject mentioned as Application for Professor
of Practice –(School/Department Name)
This is a rolling advertisement, and applications will be reviewed periodically. There is no
last date for submission of applications, and eligible candidates may apply at any time. Only
shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.
Registrar

Requirement for Assistant Professor/Associate
Professor/Professor of Practice in Computer Science and
Engineering, School of Engineering and Technology (UIET),
CSJM University, Kanpur
1. Competitive Programming
Requirement for Professor of Practice:
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Curriculum Development and Teaching:
o Design and develop advanced courses and modules on competitive
programming, algorithms, data structures, and problem-solving techniques.
o Deliver lectures and conduct practical sessions focusing on enhancing students'
competitive programming skills.
2. Mentoring and Training:
o Provide mentorship to students interested in competitive programming.
o Guide students in preparing for national and international level competitive
programming contests.
o Organize and conduct workshops, boot camps, and training sessions to build
students' problem-solving skills.
3. Industry-Academia Collaboration:
o Collaborate with industry experts to bring real-world competitive programming
challenges into the academic environment.
o Foster relationships with tech companies to facilitate internships, guest lectures,
and collaborative projects.
4. Research and Innovation:
o Encourage and support students in conducting research related to algorithms,
data structures, and other areas of computer science relevant to competitive
programming.
5. Event Organization:
o Organize and oversee intra-university coding competitions to identify and
nurture talent.
o Facilitate the participation of university teams in external competitive
programming events.
o Coordinate with other faculty members to ensure the smooth execution of
programming contests and related events.
6. Skill Development and Student Engagement:
o Engage with students outside the classroom through programming clubs, online
platforms, and coding communities.
o Track and monitor student progress and provide continuous feedback to help
them improve.
Qualifications and Experience:
1. Educational Background:
o A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is
preferred.
Page 2 of 4
o Candidates with a significant professional track record in competitive
programming or related areas may be considered even if they do not have formal
academic qualifications.
2. Professional Experience:
o At least 15 years of experience in the field of computer science, with a focus on
algorithms, data structures, and competitive programming.
o Experience in mentoring students or teams for competitive programming
contests is highly desirable.
3. Skills and Expertise:
o Strong expertise in algorithms, data structures, and problem-solving.
o Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in competitive
programming, such as C++, Python, and Java.
o Proven track record of participating in or coaching teams for competitive
programming competitions.
4. Additional Qualities:
o Excellent communication and teaching skills.
o Passion for mentoring and developing the next generation of computer science
talent.
o Ability to work collaboratively with students, faculty, and industry partners.
2. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
Requirements for Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor of Practice:
 Expertise: Deep knowledge in AI and ML concepts, including neural networks, deep
learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.
 Experience: At least 5/10/15 years of experience in AI/ML, with a proven track record
in developing AI solutions, preferably in industry or research settings.
 Roles and Responsibilities:
o Develop and teach courses on AI, machine learning algorithms, and data
science.
o Mentor students on AI/ML projects, guiding them in applying theoretical
knowledge to real-world problems.
o Lead research initiatives in AI and foster industry partnerships for collaborative
projects.
o Organize workshops and seminars to keep students and faculty updated on the
latest AI/ML trends and advancements.
3. Cybersecurity
Requirements for Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor of Practice:
 Expertise: Strong background in cybersecurity, including knowledge of cryptography,
network security, ethical hacking, and cybersecurity protocols.
 Experience: Minimum 5/10/15 years of experience in cybersecurity roles, such as
security analyst, security architect, or cybersecurity consultant, with practical
experience in managing cyber threats.
 Roles and Responsibilities:
Page 3 of 4
o Teach courses on cybersecurity principles, ethical hacking, and incident
response.
o Develop practical labs and simulations to train students in identifying and
mitigating security threats.
o Lead initiatives to strengthen the university’s cybersecurity infrastructure.
o Collaborate with industry partners to provide students with hands-on experience
through internships and real-world cybersecurity projects.
4. Data Science and Big Data Analytics
Requirements for Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor of Practice:
 Expertise: Extensive knowledge of data science, big data technologies, statistical
analysis, and data visualization tools.
 Experience: At least 5/10/15 years of experience in data analytics roles, such as data
scientist, data analyst, or big data engineer, with experience in handling large-scale data
projects.
 Roles and Responsibilities:
o Develop and teach courses on data science, big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop,
Spark), and machine learning.
o Mentor students in projects involving data analysis, predictive modeling, and
data-driven decision-making.
o Establish partnerships with industry for collaborative data science projects and
case studies.
o Organize data science competitions and hackathons to encourage student
participation in data analytics.
5. Cloud Computing
Requirements for Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor of Practice:
 Expertise: In-depth understanding of cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure,
Google Cloud), cloud architecture, and virtualization technologies.
 Experience: Minimum 5/10/15 years of experience in cloud computing, including roles
such as cloud architect, cloud engineer, or cloud consultant, with hands-on experience
in deploying and managing cloud solutions.
 Roles and Responsibilities:
o Teach courses on cloud computing fundamentals, cloud architecture, and cloud
services.
o Guide students in practical projects related to cloud deployment, cloud security,
and cloud-native application development.
o Collaborate with cloud service providers to offer students hands-on training and
certification opportunities.
o Lead research projects focused on optimizing cloud infrastructure and exploring
new cloud computing paradigms.
Page 4 of 4
6. Blockchain Technology
Requirements for Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor of Practice:
 Expertise: Solid knowledge of blockchain technology, smart contracts, decentralized
applications (dApps), and cryptographic principles.
 Experience: At least 5/10/15 years of experience in blockchain development, with
experience in implementing blockchain solutions in sectors like finance, supply chain,
or healthcare.
 Roles and Responsibilities:
o Develop and teach courses on blockchain technology, smart contracts, and
distributed ledger technologies.
o Mentor students in building blockchain-based applications and conducting
research on blockchain scalability and security.
o Facilitate partnerships with companies using blockchain to provide students
with practical exposure and internship opportunities.
o Organize blockchain workshops and hackathons to stimulate interest and
innovation in blockchain technology.
Requirement for Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor of Practice
in School of Advanced Agriculture Sciences and Technology (SAAST),
CSJM University, Kanpur
Requirement for Professor of Practice in Agriculture Science/Plant Science/ Environmental
Science
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Curriculum Development and Teaching:
 Design and develop advanced courses and modules on the various components of the
environment interact and human actions that promote environmental consciousness.
 Deliver lectures and conduct practical sessions to help students improve their skill in the
field of agriculture/environmental/plant science.
2. Mentoring and Training:
 Provide guidance to students interested in agriculture/plant/environmental science.
 Guide students in preparing for competitions in Agriculture/Plant/Environmental Science
at both the National and International levels.
 Training sessions, boot camps, and workshops are organized to help students gain
problem-solving skills.
 Training to be provided at various levels at village, forest and industry level.
3. Industry-Academia Collaboration:
 Collaborate with industry experts to bring real-world environmental challenges into the
academic environment.
 Foster relationships with tech companies to facilitate internships, guest lectures, and
collaborative projects.
4. Research and Innovation:
 To promote environmental awareness by encouraging and supporting students to conduct
research in plant sciences, environmental sciences, water harvesting, water recycling
natural/organic farming and other areas of agricultural sciences.
5. Event Organization:
 Organize and oversee intra-university environmental science/agricultural sciences
competitions to identify and nurture talent.
 Organize hands on practice in the area of agriculture and environment science.
 Coordinate with other faculty members to ensure the smooth execution of environmental
contests and related events.
6. Skill Development and Student Engagement:
 Promote environmental awareness and conserve water by using innovative water
harvesting techniques, online platforms, indigenous technique, and environmental
socialist communities to engage students beyond the classroom.
 Track and monitor student progress and provide continuous feedback to help them
improve.
 Promoting natural farming by improving soil fertility, water resources management etc.
and utilization of animal and plant residue.
Qualifications and Experience:
 Candidates with a significant professional track record in agriculture science/plant
science/environmental science or related areas may be considered even if they do not
have formal academic qualifications.
 Distinguished experts who have made remarkable contributions in their professions from
various fields such as agriculture science, technology, entrepreneurship, environmental
science, social sciences, watershed development, water-harvesting, watershed
management, water recycling, natural/organic farming, plantation, small green energy
systems.
 Those who have proven expertise in their specific profession or role with at least 10-15
years of service/experience.

1. Objectives
To use industry and professional expertise for:

societal needs, enabling CSJM University to collaborate with industry experts on
joint research projects and consultancy services.
Expert Integration: Introduce distinguished professionals from fields such as
Food Production, Food &Beverage Service, Front Office, House Keeping.
Experiential Learning: Enable university to formally associate with eminent
individuals, encouraging their participation in experiential learning, research,
training, skilling, entrepreneurship, extension, and mentoring roles.
2. Eligibility
Professional Excellence: Distinguished experts with remarkable contributions in

Develop and design courses and curricula.
Introduce new courses and deliver lectures as per university policy.

mentorship
Enhance industry-academia collaborations.
Conduct workshops, seminars, special lectures and training programs jointly with
regular faculty members.
Any other duty as assigned by the competent authority.
4. General Conditions
Exclusivity: This role is exclusive of the sanctioned posts of the university and will
not affect regular faculty recruitment.
Non-Eligibility: This position is not open to those currently in teaching professions,
whether serving or retired.
5. Categories of Engagement
Industry-Funded Professors of Practice: Industry experts involved in teaching
will benefit both the industry and the university. University may collaborate with
industries to support these positions.
University-Funded Professors of Practice: CSJM University may engage experts
in leadership positions across various fields, funded from its own resources.
Remuneration will be mutually agreed upon between the university and the expert,
depending on whether the engagement is part-time or full-time.
Honorary Professors of Practice: Experts willing to share their expertise on an
honorary basis may be engaged to benefit students.
